title: Tenant Geo-Anchor Roles and Automated Compliance Handoff
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a tenant-facing geo-anchor role model and backend orchestration to (1) let tenants declare preferred region anchors for Hosted API, (2) schedule soft pin windows and automated failover policies, and (3) produce compact, signed evidence bundles for audits. This ticket covers the product definition, API surface, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for the initial MVP (tenant opt-in pinning + attestation export).
acceptance_criteria: API: New endpoints to create/read/update tenant geo-anchor preferences: POST /v1/tenants/{id}/anchors and GET /v1/tenants/{id}/anchors
UI: Settings page where tenant admin can set primary and secondary anchors, pin window (start/end UTC), and retention profile
Routing: Requests from pinned tenants are routed to preferred region when capacity available; if not, fallback to operator-configured soft-failover policy

Evidence: System can generate an attestation bundle for a tenant for a given time window containing region routing decisions, retention profile at time-of-request, and signed checksums; bundle export available via console and S3 delivery
Telemetry: Per-tenant trace showing pin evaluation decision with cost and latency deltas visible in Console
Security: Attestation bundles are signed with KMS and include tamper-evident manifest and retrieval audit log
Docs: Confluence spec and API reference published prior to beta rollout
implementation_notes: Design decision: Use a lightweight 'anchor' object (primary, secondary, preferred_zones) instead of full region policy DSL for MVP to reduce user complexity
Trade-off: Immediate strong-lock pinning increases availability risk under regional outage; MVP will default to 'soft pin' with operator-configurable strictness to balance reliability
Data model: Tenant anchor stored in control-plane DB with per-commit versioning to enable point-in-time attestation snapshots
Evidence format: Compact JSON manifest + zipped route trace + signed metadata. We will adopt existing evidence schema used by PM-59400 but add tenant-specific deltas
APIs: Authz via existing tenant admin scopes; new events emitted to compliance-log topic for downstream evidence processor
Backend: Smart router will consult anchor cache (TTL 15s) to avoid per-request DB reads; cache invalidation on anchor updates
Retention: Attach retention_profile_id to anchor; evidence bundles must include retention settings and retention expiry calculations
Rollout: Beta to 10 tenants on dedicated pilot clusters, then gradual enablement in hosted fleet with feature-flagged routing changes
Telemetry: Add metrics: anchor_evaluations_total, anchor_fallbacks_total, anchor_evidence_exports_total
Operator tooling: Console operator page to override pins and trigger ad-hoc evidence export for incident response
